rules.title: Sensitive environment file tracked in git
rules.false_positive_analysis: Requires actual Git-index membership in the selected scan scope; .gitignore text, untracked files and example/template names do not qualify. A deliberately non-secret tracked .env still needs human review. Missing Git evidence is reported as incomplete coverage.

negative.rationale: The 'ignore-text' fixture exercises a reviewed source, applicability or identity boundary. It must remain silent without all of this rule's required local evidence; it is not a general precision claim.
